_readme: Shelves TAKEN AWAY from a crawled record, by id — the rare case where OpenStreetMap's primary tag is wrong about the door. shelves.json only ever adds (a second identity the one primary tag could not hold); this file removes, and only with a receipt. Each entry names the evidence a person read, the date, the shelves dropped, and the shelf the record should stand on instead — a correction never leaves a place shelfless. Applied by importers/import_all.py apply_curated_retags() after shelves.json. Every entry here also gets a fix-ledger line in data/fixes.json under มดเอง, and is worth fixing upstream in OSM when somebody has an editor open. Keep this file short: a long retags.json is a crawl that needs a rule, not a person with a list.

cm-osm-node-11411206869.note: หรรษา มินิกอล์ฟ / Hansa Minigolf — mapped shop=tattoo, sat on the tattoo shelf from the 2026-07-27 crawl until WO-14
cm-osm-node-11411206869.evidence: OSM node 11411206869's own tags: name=หรรษา มินิกอล์ฟ, name:en=Hansa Minigolf, name:de=Hansa Minigolf — minigolf in three languages, no tattoo attribute beyond the shop tag (cache/overpass/cm/tattoo.json, crawled 2026-07-27)

cm-osm-node-1484554967.note: Sunshine Apartment — mapped office=estate_agent, filed among the agents since the 2026-07-27 crawl; the one word the record carries names a building, not a brokerage
cm-osm-node-1484554967.evidence: OSM node 1484554967's own tags: name=Sunshine Apartment on office=estate_agent, and nothing else — no agency word anywhere on the record. Filed as an agent it hands a brokerage-hunter a building's front desk; filed as an apartment it is what its own sign says (cache/overpass/cm/realestate.json, crawled 2026-07-27)

cm-osm-way-834549399.note: Kew Mar Pan Café — filed as a hospital on the medical shelf since the 2026-07-27 crawl; found on the WO-25 ongoing-care walk
cm-osm-way-834549399.evidence: The record's own crawled description reads 'First aid room' — a first-aid point at a mountain-road café (18.5554, 98.4819, Mae Chaem side), typed healthcare on the wrong door. The name is the café's; nothing about the place is a hospital. The first-aid description stays on the record.

cm-osm-node-5416625723.note: 'animal hospital' (unnamed) — a vet standing on the people-medicine shelf; every 'hospital' search interleaved it
cm-osm-node-5416625723.evidence: The record's own name is 'animal hospital'. A veterinary hospital answers pets, not people-medicine — the pets/vet shelf is where every other vet in the catalogue stands.

cm-osm-node-6553804156.note: คำเที่ยง รักษาสัตว์ — animal care filed under medical/doctors
cm-osm-node-6553804156.evidence: รักษาสัตว์ on the sign — treats animals. Same correction as the other vets on this date.

cm-osm-way-1148815104.note: โรงพยาบาลสัตว์แม่ออน — Mae On ANIMAL hospital, on the people-medicine shelf
cm-osm-way-1148815104.evidence: โรงพยาบาลสัตว์ names the thing itself: an animal hospital. Filed with the vets where a reader looking for one will find it.

cm-osm-node-13298710901.note: รับซ่อมแซม เสื้อผ้า / repair clothes — mapped craft=tailor, and so shelved with nine bespoke-suit houses since the 2026-07-27 crawl. WO-46.
cm-osm-node-13298710901.evidence: OSM node 13298710901's own name in both languages says the trade and not the tag: name=รับซ่อมแซม เสื้อผ้า ('clothing repairs accepted'), name:en=repair clothes. Its only shop tag is craft=tailor, which OSM uses for the whole needle trade and which this shelf had been reading as bespoke. Read in cache/overpass/cm/crafts.json, crawled 2026-07-27. cat is untouched: this is still shopping.

cm-osm-node-4358877280.note: ร้านเสื้อผ้า The Bigsize — mapped amenity=restaurant and standing on the food shelf as a Thai restaurant since the 2026-07-27 crawl. Found by WO-50: of 20,894 records in two provinces this is the ONE that names itself big-size, and the directory was serving it to people looking for dinner.
cm-osm-node-4358877280.evidence: OSM node 4358877280's own name tag reads ร้านเสื้อผ้า The Bigsize — ร้านเสื้อผ้า is 'clothes shop' and it is the first word of the name. The node carries amenity=restaurant and no other tag: no cuisine, no opening_hours, nothing a restaurant mapper adds. The name is the evidence and it is in the element itself.

cm-osm-node-9893302718.note: "Motorbike & car rent 080-2464381" — arrived on the new shopping/sports-shop shelf from shop=outdoor in WO-50's first crawl. It is a vehicle rental, and the whole of the evidence is the name the mapper typed.
cm-osm-node-9893302718.evidence: OSM node 9893302718 carries shop=outdoor and exactly one other tag: name="Motorbike & car rent 080-2464381". The name states the trade and gives the phone number for it. Nothing on the element mentions outdoor equipment.
